name: Human capital per capita (real chained 2019 US$)
sourceNote: Human capital is computed as the present value of future earnings for the working population over their lifetimes.  Values are measured at market exchange rates in constant 2018 US dollars, using a country-specific GDP deflator.
sourceOrganization: World Bank. 2021. The Changing Wealth of Nations 2021: Managing Assets for the Future. Washington, DC: World Bank. doi:10.1596/978-1-4648-1590-4.
